LESSON: SARUFI 5.4.1 NYAKATI NA HALI ULIOPITA HALI TIMILIFU HALI TIMILIFU

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Sarufi 5.4.1 Nyakati na Hali uliopita hali timilifu hali timilifu

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 5.4.1 Nyakati na Hali uliopita hali timilifu hali timilifu. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ili kuzipambanua
2. kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu katika matini
3. kutumia wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ili kuzipambanua
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ili kuzipambanua. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 5.4.1 Nyakati na Hali uliopita hali timilifu hali timilifu using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 5.4.1 Nyakati na Hali uliopita hali timilifu hali timilifu in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 5.4.1 Nyakati na Hali uliopita hali timilifu hali timilifu to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 5.4.1 Nyakati na Hali uliopita hali timilifu hali timilifu.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ili kuzipambanua

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 5.4.1 Nyakati na Hali uliopita hali timilifu hali timilifu using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 5.4.1 Nyakati na Hali uliopita hali timilifu hali timilifu important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ili kuzipambanua
2. kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu katika matini
3. kutumia wakati uliopita hali timilifu na wakati ujao hali timilifu ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
